scope: Exact 36-cell static render coverage snapshot. This is not final whole-task, motion, gameplay or publication approval.
score_policy: PASS rows have all mandatory static evidence and exact 10 applicable visual gates. Additional reference dimensions require at least 9.9 and other dimensions at least 9.5. Missing or unclear evidence remains HOLD/PARTIAL; scores are not averaged.
provenance_note: I01-I06 are attributed to the genuinely separate reviewer resource_inventory, who did not build those root images. This aggregator did not duplicate that pixel review.

schema_notes.status: PASS, HOLD or PARTIAL for the row only
schema_notes.score: Exact scoped score; null for missing/unresolved evidence
schema_notes.evidence_images: Original candidate path, SHA256, byte size and dimensions
schema_notes.review_reports: Reviewer report path, SHA256 and byte size
schema_notes.source_sheet_has_other_unresolved_panels: A scoped row can pass while another panel on its current source sheet awaits repair; the whole revised source must be regressed before final selection.
